guidance.description: Ask 1 to 4 structured questions (2 to 4 options each) when requirements are underspecified or decisions are needed. A "Type something." row is appended automatically to every question (Esc cancels); never author "Other" or "Type something." labels. Put a recommended option first with "(Recommended)". Use multiSelect: true when multiple choices apply, or options[].preview (single-select only) for mockups, code snippets, diagrams, or configs that need side-by-side comparison.
promptGuidelines: Group clarifying questions into one ask_user_question call instead of stacking calls back to back.
Do not call ask_user_question in the same reply as an explanation. Wait for the next turn.
